insurance.notes: Generic covered, branded need pre-auth, ₹5K/month cap

question: HbA1c is 8.4% on Metformin 2g/day. What second-line agent should I add given his ₹5K/month insurance cap?

flags.action: Hold metformin 48h before and after IV contrast if eGFR <60.
flags.detail: Lactic acidosis. Mechanism: Risk of contrast-induced AKI → metformin accumulation → lactic acidosis.
flags.title: Metformin + IV contrast dye: SEVERE

flags.action: Limit alcohol. Avoid binge drinking. Patient education.
flags.detail: Lactic acidosis, hypoglycemia. Mechanism: Increased lactic acidosis risk; impairs gluconeogenesis.
flags.title: Metformin + Alcohol: MODERATE

flags.action: Increase antidiabetic doses during steroid course. Monitor glucose.
flags.detail: Loss of glycemic control. Mechanism: Steroids cause hyperglycemia.
flags.title: Metformin + Prednisolone / Steroids: MODERATE
